text:
Maya (PMM): ok team — want to workshop a tight set of battlecard soundbites & inbound routing rules for our next webinar + benchmark post. focus: positioning vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. keep it skimmable.
Owen - Field: love it. field needs 2 lines max for each competitor: threat + rebuttal. also call out where we win (latency, unit cost predictability, private deploy options).
Priya - GTM: add a 1‑sentence webinar hero: "How to cut inference costs 3x without sacrificing latency or control" — would that land?
Maya (PMM): shortlist of soundbite directions: 
- "Predictable inference economics, not surprise bills"
- "Same API across hosted, dedicated, private"
- "Graceful degradation when clouds are taxed"
Elaine - Content: those are good. I can write one-liners and a 2‑slide competitor comparison that sales can clip.
Sam Eng: can we include a quick benchmark note: median p99 latency at production scale on our Dedicated vs X's hosted endpoints. don't promise numbers, but show delta patterns (steady vs spiky).
Owen - Field: exactly. field loves patterns: "X = spiky latency under load; Redwood = steady p99 via autoscale + batching". short.
Priya - GTM: inbound routing thought — we should route high-usage trialers + security requests to AE/solutions, smaller PLG signups to self‑serve nurture. also flag any requests mentioning "on-prem" or "VPC" for enterprise follow-up.
Maya (PMM): propose simple routing rules. Elaine — can you add the copy for the webhook that expresses these flags?
Elaine - Content: sure. Draft webhook payload example for routing (for eng):
```
{ "email": "acct@example.com", "usage_tpm": 12000, "mentions": ["on-prem","SLA","private"], "route": "ae-eu" }
```
Maya (PMM): nice. Sam — any objections to exposing those flags in the signup form?
Sam Eng: fine. we should also compute a derived field: "projected_monthly_cost" from tpm and model class to help routing. can show formula in battlecard appendix.
Owen - Field: for battlecards vs infra vendors, field needs a quick callout about "ops burden". soundbite: "We manage inference so you don't hire a cluster ops team."
Priya - GTM: webinar CTA matrix:
- Enterprise signups -> contact AE -> 1:1 demo
- High-usage trials -> AE + solutions email sequence
- PLG -> self-serve drip + 2-week usage playbook
Maya (PMM): good. Elaine, put those in the battlecard bullets. include rebuttal snippets for common claims:
- Claim: "Cloud infra is cheaper if you self-manage" -> Rebuttal: "Self-manage shifts cost from $/token to headcount and ops cycles; Redwood optimizes $/token with batching & KV caching plus ops included."
- Claim: "APIs are easier, just use their hosted endpoints" -> Rebuttal: "Hosted APIs can be black-box and unpredictable at scale; Redwood gives API speed with discoverable SLAs and private control planes."
Elaine - Content: I'll craft the bullets. also will add a short 30s webinar soundbite for the host.
routing-bot: :white_check_mark: rule created: high_usage (tpm>5000) -> tag:ae, security_flag if mentions contain [on-prem,VPC] -> tag:security
Priya - GTM: side note — benchmark narrative: avoid raw figures in public deck; instead use normalized charts (index to baseline) and call out "typical improvement band". keeps legal safe.
Sam Eng: agree. add methodology blurb: test harness uses sustained 2k concurrent streams, mixed prompt lengths, same model families, KV warmed.
Owen - Field: final ask from me: 3 one-liners for voicemail/email templates for AEs when they get routed leads. quick, no fluff.
Maya (PMM): can everyone drop drafts by EOD? I'll consolidate into the battlecard v0 and a one-page cheat sheet for sales.
Elaine - Content: dropping drafts now. starting with: "We help teams stabilize inference latency and cut per-token spend without locking into a single cloud. Can we schedule 20m?"
Owen - Field: dropping voicemail lines.
Priya - GTM: will update the webhook rules in SFDC flow after we test.
Sam Eng: I'll add the benchmark appendix and the projected_cost formula.
Maya (PMM): awesome. follow-ups: Elaine -> battlecard copy, Sam -> appendix, Priya -> routing integration, Owen -> AE templates. I'll stitch and push to the marketing drive by tomorrow 11am. :rocket:
